subject.title: Control UI: Avatar metadata requests omit authentication when Gateway auth is enabled

question: Does repository history conclusively identify the commit and first release that added bearer authentication to Control UI avatar metadata and image fetches?
rationale: Current behavior and regression tests show the reported bug is absent, but the conservative close policy requires exact fix and release provenance rather than inferring it from nearby avatar history.

options.title: Confirm provenance and close
options.body: Identify the exact auth-fix SHA and first containing tag, then close this issue as implemented on main or shipped.

options.title: Keep open temporarily
options.body: Leave the issue open until blame or release history can distinguish the bearer-header fix from the adjacent mounted-path avatar change.

recommendation.title: Confirm provenance and close
recommendation.body: Identify the exact auth-fix SHA and first containing tag, then close this issue as implemented on main or shipped.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest concrete history signal is the recent avatar metadata correction on the same Control UI path.
